description: Gigs on the calendar between two dates (default: the next 90 days). q = free-text search across client, project, act, show, venue, city/state and the date's notes — with q and no dates it searches ALL dates, past and future. act_id = only dates played by that act (comma-separate several; 0 = dates with no act). Each gig carries its effective act_id/act_name (the date's act, else the booking's, else the show's).

from.description: The sender — an email address or phone number, per the tool.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (integer; default varies, cap ~100).

q.description: Search text; with multiple words, all must match.

to.description: The recipient — an email address or phone number, per the tool.
